trait.introvert.name: Introvert
trait.placid.desc: Calm; fun drains slowly, but works slowly too.
trait.placid.name: Placid
trait.sociable.desc: Loves to chat; gets bored quickly when alone.
trait.sociable.name: Outgoing
trait.sturdy.name: Robust
villager.ayse.event.ayse_1: Ayşe showed you how to knead clay.
villager.ayse.event.ayse_2: Ayşe gave you her first beautiful cup.
villager.ayse.event.ayse_3: Ayşe went into partnership with you on a pottery kiln.
villager.elif.event.elif_1: Elif showed you how to tie a knot stitch.
villager.elif.event.elif_2: Elif told you the secret of fixing color with root dyes.
villager.elif.event.elif_3: Elif embroidered a handkerchief and gave it to you as a gift.
villager.hasan.event.hasan_1: Hasan showed you how to plane along the grain of the wood.
villager.hasan.event.hasan_2: Hasan told you the story of an old carved chair.
villager.hasan.event.hasan_3: Hasan counted you among those who will always find his workshop door open.
villager.hatice.event.hatice_1: Hatice taught you the finer points of fresh bread dough.
villager.hatice.event.hatice_2: Hatice told you the story of the millstone.
villager.hatice.event.hatice_3: Hatice entrusted you with her own recipe.
villager.kemal.event.kemal_1: Kemal told you at which bend of the river the pike lie in wait.
villager.kemal.event.kemal_2: Kemal showed you the tricks of casting a net at dawn.
villager.kemal.event.kemal_3: Kemal showed his best fishing spot to you alone.
villager.kerem.event.kerem_1: Kerem told you stories of faraway fairs.
villager.kerem.event.kerem_2: Kerem offered you a special price at the market.
villager.kerem.event.kerem_3: Kerem offered you his company on the road and a purse of akçe.
villager.murat.event.murat_1: Murat told you about the highland pastures he roams with his flock.
villager.murat.event.murat_2: Murat invited you to the birth of a lamb.
villager.murat.event.murat_3: Murat gave you a keepsake made from his first lamb's wool.
villager.mustafa.event.mustafa_1: Mustafa showed you how he finds a crack by the sound of the stone.
villager.mustafa.event.mustafa_2: Mustafa told you how he and his father built the village's old bridge.
villager.mustafa.event.mustafa_3: Mustafa gave you a dressed stone for your hearth.
villager.orhan.event.orhan_1: Orhan told you some of the smith's secrets by the forge.
villager.orhan.event.orhan_2: Orhan showed you his old hammer and told you about the village's first smithy.
villager.orhan.event.orhan_3: Orhan declared you "a child of the village" and gave you a sack of charcoal.
villager.riza.event.riza_1: Rıza told you how a good saddle protects the horse's back.
villager.riza.event.riza_2: Rıza laughed as he told you how he got used to the smell of tanning.
villager.riza.event.riza_3: Rıza said he knows you as someone who takes good care of their horse.
villager.selim.event.selim_1: Selim found a line about your family in the village's old records.
villager.selim.event.selim_2: Selim taught you the finer points of calligraphy.
villager.selim.event.selim_3: Selim wrote your name in the family register in his own decorated hand.
villager.serife.event.serife_1: Şerife told you the gossip of the travelers staying at the inn.
villager.serife.event.serife_2: Şerife whispered a soup recipe handed down from her mother.
villager.serife.event.serife_3: Şerife declared you the inn's guest of honor.
villager.zeynep.event.zeynep_1: Zeynep told you which herbs to gather before winter.
villager.zeynep.event.zeynep_2: Zeynep showed you a hidden mushroom spot in the forest.
villager.zeynep.event.zeynep_3: Zeynep gave you a jar of honey.
